authority_boundaries: GitHub release publication is distribution, not deployment.
Release attestation certifies exact repository/package/distribution state, not empirical truth or causal validity.
Calibration reliability, cross-fitted estimates, Gaussian belief state, approximation envelopes, robust plans and deployment plans do not become Y1 authority by publication.
Decision-time history validation prevents future/outcome look-ahead but does not prove causal identification assumptions.
Unknown or non-finite model coordinates are rejected; validation does not prove that supplied finite coordinates are empirically correct.
A missing radius-eligible approximation witness remains a missing local certificate; an unrestricted global envelope cannot silently satisfy a declared locality constraint.
Trusted PROMOTION.2 qualification is not GitHub administrative hardening.
A tag or release does not authorize treatment execution, production secrets, infrastructure mutation or external package-index publication.
Deployment.2 is external-control planning and receipt verification, not proof that production infrastructure was changed.
A v3.3.0 release attestation is not evidence for v3.4.0 bytes.
